September 2009. Vendored here byte for byte as `rfc5646.txt`.

Used by `tools/hreflang/test/index.test.ts`, which asserts every Appendix A
example (whitespace removed) is a substring of this vendored file (whitespace
removed), so a transcription error fails the test instead of passing.
